operations.name: Get Gateways
operations.description:
Get the gateways in your deployment that match the filter from a Network Discovery scan. 
Network Discovery requires a Network Discovery license.

responses.description: Invalid user input received. See error details for further information.
Unauthorized access - please sign in and retry.

query.name: accountIds
query.description: List of Account IDs to filter by. Example: "225494730938493804,225494730938493915".

query.name: agentPercentage__between
query.description: Percentage of agents of the account in this network calculated as numberOfAgents/totalAgents * 100. Example: "70-80".

query.name: agentPercentage__gt
query.description: Agent percentage (more than)

query.name: agentPercentage__gte
query.description: Agent percentage (more than or equal)

query.name: agentPercentage__lt
query.description: Agent percentage (less than)

query.name: agentPercentage__lte
query.description: Agent percentage (less than or equal)

query.name: allowScan
query.description: Do we allow scanning in this network

query.name: archived
query.description: Archived network

query.name: connectedRangers__between
query.description: The total of non decommissioned agents in the account. Example: "2-8".

query.name: connectedRangers__gt
query.description: Total agents (more than)

query.name: connectedRangers__gte
query.description: Total agents (more than or equal)

query.name: connectedRangers__lt
query.description: Total agents (less than)

query.name: connectedRangers__lte
query.description: Total agents (less than or equal)

query.name: countOnly
query.description: If true, only total number of items will be returned, without any of the actual objects.

query.name: createdAt__between
query.description: Date range for creation time (format: <from_timestamp>-<to_timestamp>, inclusive). Example: "1514978890136-1514978650130".

query.name: createdAt__gt
query.description: Gateway created after this timestamp. Example: "2018-02-27T04:49:26.257525Z".

query.name: createdAt__gte
query.description: Gateway created after or at this timestamp. Example: "2018-02-27T04:49:26.257525Z".

query.name: createdAt__lt
query.description: Gateway created before this timestamp. Example: "2018-02-27T04:49:26.257525Z".

query.name: createdAt__lte
query.description: Gateway created before or at this timestamp. Example: "2018-02-27T04:49:26.257525Z".

query.name: cursor
query.description: Cursor position returned by the last request. Use to iterate over more than 1000 items. Example: "YWdlbnRfaWQ6NTgwMjkzODE=".

query.name: externalIp
query.description: Search external ip using a CIDR expression or exact IP

query.name: externalIp__contains
query.description: Free-text filter by visible IP (supports multiple values). Example: "192.168.0.1/24,10.1".

query.name: icmpScan
query.description: ICMP scan enabled

query.name: ip
query.description: Search ip using a CIDR expression exact IP

query.name: ip__contains
query.description: Free-text filter by IP Address (supports multiple values). Example: "192.168.0.1/24,10.1".

query.name: limit
query.description: Limit number of returned items (1-1000). Example: "10".

query.name: macAddress
query.description: The gateway mac address

query.name: macAddress__contains
query.description: Free-text filter by mac address (supports multiple values). Example: "aa:ee:b1".

query.name: manufacturer
query.description: The gateway manufacturer obtained from the mac address

query.name: manufacturer__contains
query.description: Free-text filter by manufacturer (supports multiple values). Example: "Company".

query.name: mdnsScan
query.description: MDNS scan enabled

query.name: networkName__contains
query.description: Free-text filter by network name (supports multiple values). Example: "Network1".

query.name: new
query.description: True if this is network was first seen some days ago, 3 by default

query.name: numberOfAgents__between
query.description: The number of non decommissioned agents in this network. Example: "2-8".

query.name: numberOfAgents__gt
query.description: Agent count (more than)

query.name: numberOfAgents__gte
query.description: Agent count (more than or equal)

query.name: numberOfAgents__lt
query.description: Agent count (less than)

query.name: numberOfAgents__lte
query.description: Agent count (less than or equal)

query.name: numberOfRangers__between
query.description: The number of non decommissioned agents in this network. Example: "2-8".

query.name: numberOfRangers__gt
query.description: Network Discovery count (more than)

query.name: numberOfRangers__gte
query.description: Network Discovery count (more than or equal)

query.name: numberOfRangers__lt
query.description: Network Discovery count (less than)

query.name: numberOfRangers__lte
query.description: Network Discovery count (less than or equal)

query.name: query
query.description: Free text query

query.name: rdnsScan
query.description: RDNS scan enabled

query.name: scanOnlyLocalSubnets
query.description: Allow remote tasks form this network

query.name: siteIds
query.description: List of Site IDs to filter by. Example: "225494730938493804,225494730938493915".

query.name: skip
query.description: Skip first number of items (0-1000). To iterate over more than 1000 items,  use "cursor". Example: "150".

query.name: skipCount
query.description: If true, total number of items will not be calculated, which speeds up execution time.

query.name: smbScan
query.description: SMB scan enabled

query.name: snmpScan
query.description: SNMP scan enabled

query.name: sortBy
query.description: The column to sort the results by. Example: "id".

query.name: sortOrder
query.description: Sort direction. Example: "asc".

query.name: tcpPorts__contains
query.description: Free-text filter by tcp port (supports multiple values). Example: "80,24".

query.name: totalAgents__between
query.description: The total of non decommissioned agents in the account. Example: "2-8".

query.name: totalAgents__gt
query.description: Total agents (more than)

query.name: totalAgents__gte
query.description: Total agents (more than or equal)

query.name: totalAgents__lt
query.description: Total agents (less than)

query.name: totalAgents__lte
query.description: Total agents (less than or equal)

query.name: udpPorts__contains
query.description: Free-text filter by udp port (supports multiple values). Example: "137,2002".

query.name: updatedAt__between
query.description: Date range for update time (format: <from_timestamp>-<to_timestamp>, inclusive). Example: "1514978890136-1514978650130".

query.name: updatedAt__gt
query.description: Gateway updated after this timestamp. Example: "2018-02-27T04:49:26.257525Z".

query.name: updatedAt__gte
query.description: Gateway updated after or at this timestamp. Example: "2018-02-27T04:49:26.257525Z".

query.name: updatedAt__lt
query.description: Gateway updated before this timestamp. Example: "2018-02-27T04:49:26.257525Z".

query.name: updatedAt__lte
query.description: Gateway updated before or at this timestamp. Example: "2018-02-27T04:49:26.257525Z".
